evidence: "The two variables chosen from all the selection methods, age and leukocytes, appear to be key influencing factors for physical frailty syndrome." And: "The two described variables were followed in terms of importance by self-assessed health status, GFR, EQ-5D index, and handgrip strength." The paper ranks variables by selection frequency from impurity-based and information-theoretic methods, without corroboration via permutation importance, SHAP, PDP/ALE, conditional importance, or held-out validation. Features span laboratory values (sodium, potassium, glucose, creatinine), questionnaires (SARC-F, EQ-5D), physical measures, and demographics—mixed types and scales."
